USERSPACE_NETWORK_SOURCE
// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
// Matched userspace network control: same page ABI and resident GPU dispatcher.
#include <sys/epoll.h>
#include <cerrno>
#include <cstring>
#include <map>
#include <memory>
#include <string>
#include <chrono>

static int user_network(bf_page *page,int listener,unsigned seconds,
                        volatile sig_atomic_t *stopped) {
    struct Peer {
        int fd;
        bool eof=false;
        int slot=-1;
        std::string input;
    };
    struct Reply {
        std::shared_ptr<Peer> peer;
        std::string header;
        size_t header_sent=0,bytes=0;
    } replies[BF_LLM_SLOTS];
    std::map<int,std::shared_ptr<Peer>> peers;
    unsigned head=0,completed=0,rejected_count=0,accepted=0;
    int ep=epoll_create1(EPOLL_CLOEXEC);
    if(ep<0) { perror("epoll_create1");return 1; }
    fcntl(listener,F_SETFL,fcntl(listener,F_GETFL)|O_NONBLOCK);
    epoll_event watch={};watch.events=EPOLLIN;watch.data.fd=listener;
    if(epoll_ctl(ep,EPOLL_CTL_ADD,listener,&watch)) { close(ep);return 1; }
    auto disconnect=[&](Peer &peer) {
        if(peer.fd>=0) {
            epoll_ctl(ep,EPOLL_CTL_DEL,peer.fd,nullptr);
            close(peer.fd);peer.fd=-1;
        }
        peer.eof=true;
    };
    auto send_part=[&](Peer &peer,const void *data,size_t count) {
        ssize_t n=send(peer.fd,data,count,MSG_DONTWAIT|MSG_NOSIGNAL);
        if(n<0 && errno!=EAGAIN && errno!=EWOULDBLOCK && errno!=EINTR)
            disconnect(peer);
        return n>0 ? (size_t)n : (size_t)0;
    };
    auto deadline=std::chrono::steady_clock::now()+std::chrono::seconds(seconds);
    while(!*stopped && std::chrono::steady_clock::now()<deadline) {
        // Busy completion polling is a low-latency control; report its CPU cost.
        epoll_event events[BF_LLM_SLOTS*2];
        int n=epoll_wait(ep,events,BF_LLM_SLOTS*2,0);
        if(n<0 && errno!=EINTR) { perror("epoll_wait");break; }
        for(int e=0;e<n;e++) {
            int fd=events[e].data.fd;
            if(fd==listener) {
                while(true) {
                    int child=accept4(listener,nullptr,nullptr,SOCK_NONBLOCK|SOCK_CLOEXEC);
                    if(child<0) break;
                    auto peer=std::make_shared<Peer>();peer->fd=child;
                    peers[child]=peer;accepted++;
                    watch.events=EPOLLIN|EPOLLRDHUP;watch.data.fd=child;
                    if(epoll_ctl(ep,EPOLL_CTL_ADD,child,&watch)) disconnect(*peer);
                }
            } else {
                auto it=peers.find(fd);if(it==peers.end()) continue;
                Peer &peer=*it->second;
                char buffer[4096];
                while(peer.fd>=0) {
                    ssize_t got=recv(peer.fd,buffer,sizeof(buffer),MSG_DONTWAIT);
                    if(got>0) peer.input.append(buffer,got);
                    else {
                        if(got==0) {
                            peer.eof=true;epoll_ctl(ep,EPOLL_CTL_DEL,peer.fd,nullptr);
                        } else if(errno!=EAGAIN && errno!=EWOULDBLOCK && errno!=EINTR)
                            disconnect(peer);
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        for(unsigned i=0;i<BF_LLM_SLOTS;i++) {
            Reply &reply=replies[i];if(!reply.peer) continue;
            Peer &peer=*reply.peer;bf_llm_slot *slot=&page->llm[i];
            unsigned state=__atomic_load_n(&slot->state,__ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);
            unsigned short flags=__atomic_load_n(&slot->pad,__ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);
            bool rejected=flags&BF_LLM_REJECTED;
            if((flags&BF_LLM_VALIDATING) || (rejected && state!=BF_DONE)) continue;
            unsigned produced=__atomic_load_n(&slot->produced,__ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);
            if(state!=BF_DONE && produced==slot->n_gen && produced) produced--;
            if(rejected && (flags&BF_LLM_TRANSPORT_MASK)==1) disconnect(peer);
            if((flags&BF_LLM_TRANSPORT_MASK)==2 && reply.header.empty()) {
                reply.header="HTTP/1.1 "+std::string(rejected ? "400 Bad Request" : "200 OK")
                    +"\r\nContent-Type: application/octet-stream\r\nContent-Length: "
                    +std::to_string(rejected ? 0 : slot->n_gen*4)+"\r\n\r\n";
            }
            if(peer.fd>=0 && reply.header_sent<reply.header.size())
                reply.header_sent+=send_part(peer,reply.header.data()+reply.header_sent,
                                            reply.header.size()-reply.header_sent);
            if(peer.fd>=0 && reply.header_sent==reply.header.size() && produced*4>reply.bytes)
                reply.bytes+=send_part(peer,(char *)slot->tok_out+reply.bytes,produced*4-reply.bytes);
            if(state==BF_DONE && (peer.fd<0 ||
                (reply.header_sent==reply.header.size() && reply.bytes==produced*4))) {
                peer.slot=-1;reply={};
                __atomic_store_n(&slot->state,(unsigned)BF_FREE,__ATOMIC_RELEASE);
                completed++;if(rejected) rejected_count++;
            }
        }
        for(auto it=peers.begin();it!=peers.end();) {
            auto peer=it->second;
            if(peer->fd>=0 && peer->slot<0 && !peer->input.empty()) {
                size_t offset=0;
                bool http=peer->input.compare(0,4,"POST")==0;
                if(http) {
                    size_t end=peer->input.find("\r\n\r\n");
                    if(end==std::string::npos) { ++it;continue; }
                    offset=end+4;
                }
                if(peer->input.size()<offset+24) { ++it;continue; }
                unsigned fields[4];unsigned long long client_ns;
                memcpy(fields,peer->input.data()+offset,16);
                memcpy(&client_ns,peer->input.data()+offset+16,8);
                unsigned prompt=fields[1],gen=fields[2];
                if(fields[0]!=BF_LLM_MAGIC || !prompt || prompt>BF_LLM_MAX_TOK ||
                   !gen || gen>BF_LLM_MAX_TOK) {
                    disconnect(*peer);
                } else {
                    size_t bytes=24+prompt*4;
                    if(http) {
                        size_t key=peer->input.find("\r\nContent-Length: ");
                        if(key==std::string::npos || key>=offset ||
                           strtoul(peer->input.c_str()+key+18,nullptr,10)!=bytes) {
                            disconnect(*peer);++it;continue;
                        }
                    }
                    if(peer->input.size()<offset+bytes) { ++it;continue; }
                    unsigned i=head%BF_LLM_SLOTS;bf_llm_slot *slot=&page->llm[i];
                    if(__atomic_load_n(&slot->state,__ATOMIC_ACQUIRE)==BF_FREE) {
                        __atomic_store_n(&slot->state,(unsigned)BF_WRITING,__ATOMIC_RELEASE);
                        slot->n_prompt=prompt;slot->n_gen=gen;slot->produced=0;
                        slot->client_ns=client_ns;
                        slot->pad=(http ? 2 : 1)|BF_LLM_VALIDATING;
                        memcpy(slot->tok_in,peer->input.data()+offset+24,prompt*4);
                        peer->input.erase(0,offset+bytes);
                        replies[i].peer=peer;peer->slot=i;
                        __atomic_store_n(&slot->state,(unsigned)BF_PENDING,__ATOMIC_RELEASE);
                        __atomic_store_n(&page->llm_head,++head,__ATOMIC_RELEASE);
                    }
                }
            }
            if(peer->slot<0 && (peer->fd<0 || (peer->eof && peer->input.empty()))) {
                disconnect(*peer);it=peers.erase(it);
            } else ++it;
        }
    }
    for(auto &item:peers) disconnect(*item.second);
    close(ep);
    printf("userspace TCP stopped: accepted=%u published=%u completed=%u rejected=%u\n",
           accepted,head,completed,rejected_count);fflush(stdout);
    return 0;
}

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
"""Matched HF graph dispatch/network controls on the token HTTP path."""
import argparse
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
import json
import math
import os
from pathlib import Path
import platform
import socket
import statistics
import struct
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import threading
import time

sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]/"tests"))
from resident_qwen import oracle_cases


def command(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(args,text=True,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT).strip()


def cpu_seconds(pid):
    fields=Path(f"/proc/{pid}/stat").read_text().rsplit(") ",1)[1].split()
    return (int(fields[11])+int(fields[12]))/os.sysconf("SC_CLK_TCK")


def host_cpu_ticks():
    # Global host counters include clients, kernel work and other workloads.
    return [int(value) for value in Path("/proc/stat").read_text().splitlines()[0].split()[1:]]


def gpu_state():
    return command("nvidia-smi","--query-gpu=timestamp,name,clocks.sm,clocks.mem,temperature.gpu,power.draw,utilization.gpu","--format=csv,noheader,nounits")


def request(client,ids,expected):
    body=struct.pack("<IIIIQ",0x514c4d51,len(ids),len(expected),0,time.monotonic_ns())+struct.pack(f"<{len(ids)}I",*ids)
    wire=f"POST /generate HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: localhost\r\nContent-Length: {len(body)}\r\n\r\n".encode()+body
    start=time.monotonic_ns()
    client.sendall(wire)
    header=b""; data=b""; arrivals=[]
    while len(data)<4*len(expected):
        chunk=client.recv(4096)
        arrived=time.monotonic_ns()
        assert chunk,"short reply"
        if header is not None:
            header+=chunk
            if b"\r\n\r\n" not in header: continue
            head,chunk=header.split(b"\r\n\r\n",1)
            assert head.startswith(b"HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\n"),head
            assert f"Content-Length: {4*len(expected)}".encode() in head,head
            header=None
        data+=chunk
        arrivals.extend([arrived]*((len(data)//4)-len(arrivals)))
    assert len(data)==4*len(expected),data
    actual=list(struct.unpack(f"<{len(expected)}I",data))
    assert actual==expected,(ids,actual,expected)
    return {"start_ns":start,"arrival_ns":arrivals,"tokens":actual,
            "ttft_ms":(arrivals[0]-start)/1e6,
            "latency_ms":(arrivals[-1]-start)/1e6,
            "tpot_ms":(arrivals[-1]-arrivals[0])/(len(expected)-1)/1e6 if len(expected)>1 else None}


def connect():
    client=socket.create_connection(("127.0.0.1",39403),timeout=60)
    client.setsockopt(socket.IPPROTO_TCP,socket.TCP_NODELAY,1)
    return client


def cell(pid,cases,gen,concurrency,count,rows):
    # Connections and thread creation precede both the timer and CPU window.
    barrier=threading.Barrier(concurrency+1)
    ready=threading.Barrier(concurrency+1)
    def worker(worker_id):
        with connect() as client:
            ready.wait(timeout=60)
            barrier.wait(timeout=60)
            for index in range(worker_id,count,concurrency):
                case=index%len(cases); ids,expected=cases[case]
                row=request(client,ids,expected[:gen]); row.update(index=index,case=case)
                rows.append(row)
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=concurrency) as pool:
        futures=[pool.submit(worker,i) for i in range(concurrency)]
        ready.wait(timeout=60)
        before=cpu_seconds(pid); host_before=host_cpu_ticks(); start=time.monotonic_ns()
        barrier.wait(timeout=60)
        for future in futures: future.result()
        finish=time.monotonic_ns(); host_after=host_cpu_ticks(); after=cpu_seconds(pid)
    first=min(row["start_ns"] for row in rows)
    last=max(row["arrival_ns"][-1] for row in rows)
    return {
        "window_ns":finish-start,"executor_cpu_s":after-before,
        "host_cpu_ticks_before":host_before,"host_cpu_ticks_after":host_after,
        "host_cpu_work_s":sum(host_after[i]-host_before[i] for i in (0,1,2,5,6))/os.sysconf("SC_CLK_TCK"),
        "output_tokens_per_s":count*gen/((last-first)/1e9)}


def analyze(path):
    records=[json.loads(line) for line in Path(path).read_text().splitlines()]
    meta=next(row for row in records if row["event"]=="metadata")
    cells=[row for row in records if row["event"]=="cell"]
    samples=[row for row in records if row["event"]=="request"]
    expected_cells=meta["repetitions"]*2*len(meta["matrix"])
    assert len(cells)==expected_cells,(len(cells),expected_cells)
    assert len(samples)==expected_cells*meta["requests_per_cell"]
    assert len([row for row in records if row["event"]=="executor"])==2*meta["repetitions"]
    for row in samples:
        assert row["tokens"]==meta["cases"][row["case"]][1][:row["gen"]],row
        assert row["ttft_ms"]==(row["arrival_ns"][0]-row["start_ns"])/1e6,row
    for block in cells:
        selected=[row for row in samples if all(row[key]==block[key] for key in ("pair","mode","gen","concurrency"))]
        assert sorted(row["index"] for row in selected)==list(range(meta["requests_per_cell"])),block
    def percentile(values,q):
        ordered=sorted(values); pos=(len(ordered)-1)*q
        low=math.floor(pos); high=math.ceil(pos)
        return ordered[low]+(ordered[high]-ordered[low])*(pos-low)
    modes=tuple(meta["executors"]);control=modes[1]
    for gen,concurrency in meta["matrix"]:
        pair_means={}
        for mode in modes:
            selected=[row for row in samples if row["mode"]==mode and row["gen"]==gen and row["concurrency"]==concurrency]
            selected_cells=[row for row in cells if row["mode"]==mode and row["gen"]==gen and row["concurrency"]==concurrency]
            ttft=[row["ttft_ms"] for row in selected]
            tpot=[row["tpot_ms"] for row in selected if row["tpot_ms"] is not None]
            pair_means[mode]=[statistics.mean(row["ttft_ms"] for row in selected if row["pair"]==pair) for pair in range(meta["repetitions"])]
            print(json.dumps({"mode":mode,"gen":gen,"concurrency":concurrency,"requests":len(selected),
                "ttft_mean_ms":statistics.mean(ttft),"ttft_p50_ms":percentile(ttft,.5),"ttft_p99_ms":percentile(ttft,.99),
                "tpot_mean_ms":statistics.mean(tpot) if tpot else None,
                "completion_mean_ms":statistics.mean(row["latency_ms"] for row in selected),
                "host_cpu_work_s_per_cell":[row.get("host_cpu_work_s") for row in selected_cells],
                "executor_cpu_s_per_cell":[row["executor_cpu_s"] for row in selected_cells],
                "tokens_per_s":[row["output_tokens_per_s"] for row in selected_cells]}))
        differences=[host-resident for host,resident in zip(pair_means[control],pair_means["resident"])]
        mean=statistics.mean(differences)
        # Five independent paired process blocks; Student t, df=4, two-sided 95%.
        margin=2.776445105*statistics.stdev(differences)/math.sqrt(5) if len(differences)==5 else None
        print(json.dumps({"gen":gen,"concurrency":concurrency,("paired_host_minus_resident_ttft_ms" if control=="host-launch" else "paired_user_network_minus_resident_ttft_ms"):differences,
            "difference_mean_ms":mean,"difference_t95_ms":[mean-margin,mean+margin] if margin is not None else None}))
        differences=[next(row["output_tokens_per_s"] for row in cells if row["pair"]==pair and row["mode"]=="resident" and row["gen"]==gen and row["concurrency"]==concurrency)-
                     next(row["output_tokens_per_s"] for row in cells if row["pair"]==pair and row["mode"]==control and row["gen"]==gen and row["concurrency"]==concurrency) for pair in range(meta["repetitions"])]
        mean=statistics.mean(differences)
        margin=2.776445105*statistics.stdev(differences)/math.sqrt(5) if len(differences)==5 else None
        print(json.dumps({"gen":gen,"concurrency":concurrency,("paired_resident_minus_host_tps" if control=="host-launch" else "paired_resident_minus_user_network_tps"):differences,
            "difference_mean_tps":mean,"difference_t95_tps":[mean-margin,mean+margin] if margin is not None else None}))


def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--output",required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--preflight",action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--gen",type=int,default=8,choices=range(2,65),help="long output length; paired with one-token requests")
    parser.add_argument("--analyze",action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--resident-executor",default="./build/qwen")
    parser.add_argument("--host-executor",default="./build/qwen_host_launch")
    parser.add_argument("--user-network-executor",help="same resident GPU compute with userspace network control")
    parser.add_argument("--model",default="Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct",help="HF checkpoint for graph executors")
    args=parser.parse_args()
    if args.analyze: analyze(args.output); return
    control="user-network" if args.user_network_executor else "host-launch"
    executors={"resident":args.resident_executor,control:args.user_network_executor or args.host_executor}
    if args.model!="Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct" and any("qwen_graph" not in Path(binary).name for binary in executors.values()):
        parser.error("--model requires graph executors")
    weights="/workspaces/.cache/bpfusion/qwen25-05b-fp16.bin" if args.model=="Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct" else args.model
    cases,_=oracle_cases(args.gen,name=args.model)
    matrix=[(1,1)] if args.preflight else [(1,1),(args.gen,1),(1,8),(args.gen,8)]
    repetitions=1 if args.preflight else 5
    count=4 if args.preflight else 64
    output=Path(args.output); output.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    with output.open("x") as raw:
        def emit(event,**values):
            raw.write(json.dumps({"event":event,**values})+"\n"); raw.flush()
        import torch, transformers
        emit("metadata",utc=time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ",time.gmtime()),commit=command("git","rev-parse","HEAD"),
             executors=executors,model=args.model,
             network_control="native epoll busy polling, anonymous CUDA-registered page; same resident GPU dispatcher" if args.user_network_executor else None,
             kernel=platform.release(),torch=torch.__version__,transformers=transformers.__version__,
             nvcc=command("/usr/local/cuda/bin/nvcc","--version"),gpu=gpu_state(),cpu_tick_hz=os.sysconf("SC_CLK_TCK"),
             cases=cases,matrix=matrix,repetitions=repetitions,requests_per_cell=count,
             timing="client monotonic; tokens completed in one recv share arrival timestamp; process CPU excludes kernel TX/softirq",
             host_cpu="global /proc/stat user+nice+system+irq+softirq; includes clients and unrelated host workloads; approximate cell window, not service attribution")
        for pair in range(repetitions):
            modes=("resident",control) if pair%2==0 else (control,"resident")
            cells=matrix[pair%len(matrix):]+matrix[:pair%len(matrix)]
            for mode in modes:
                executor=None
                with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="bpfusion-dispatch-") as tmp:
                    logpath=Path(tmp)/"executor.log"
                    try:
                        if mode!="user-network":command("./build/bpfusion_load","stream-attach")
                        else:assert not Path("/sys/module/bfusion_tx").exists(),"kernel TX must be absent for network control"
                        binary=executors[mode]
                        started=time.monotonic()
                        with logpath.open("w") as log:
                            executor=subprocess.Popen([binary,weights,"300"],stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
                        while "resident Qwen ready" not in logpath.read_text():
                            assert executor.poll() is None,logpath.read_text()
                            time.sleep(.05)
                        emit("bootstrap",pair=pair,mode=mode,seconds=time.monotonic()-started)
                        with connect() as client:
                            for gen in (1,args.gen):
                                for ids,expected in cases: request(client,ids,expected[:gen])
                        before=cpu_seconds(executor.pid); idle_start=time.monotonic_ns(); time.sleep(1)
                        emit("idle",pair=pair,mode=mode,window_ns=time.monotonic_ns()-idle_start,executor_cpu_s=cpu_seconds(executor.pid)-before)
                        for gen,concurrency in cells:
                            gpu_before=gpu_state()
                            rows=[]
                            try:
                                summary=cell(executor.pid,cases,gen,concurrency,count,rows)
                            finally:
                                for row in sorted(rows,key=lambda row:row["index"]):
                                    emit("request",pair=pair,mode=mode,gen=gen,concurrency=concurrency,**row)
                            gpu_after=gpu_state()
                            emit("cell",pair=pair,mode=mode,gen=gen,concurrency=concurrency,requests=count,
                                 gpu_before=gpu_before,gpu_after=gpu_after,**summary)
                            print(f"pair={pair} mode={mode} gen={gen} c={concurrency} requests={count} exact_tokens={count*gen} cpu_s={summary['executor_cpu_s']:.3f}",flush=True)
                        executor.terminate(); assert executor.wait(timeout=60)==0,logpath.read_text()
                        log=logpath.read_text(); launches=1 if mode in ("resident","user-network") else 8+count*len(matrix)
                        dispatch="resident" if mode=="user-network" else mode
                        assert f"dispatch={dispatch} launches={launches}" in log,log
                        if mode=="user-network":
                            requests=8+count*len(matrix)
                            assert f"published={requests} completed={requests} rejected=0" in log,log
                            assert "network=userspace epoll" in log,log
                            assert not Path("/sys/module/bfusion_tx").exists()
                        if "device_graph_launches=" in log:
                            model_steps=4*(1+args.gen)+count*sum(gen for gen,_ in matrix)
                            assert f"device_graph_launches={model_steps} graph_error=0 banks=8" in log,log
                            if not args.preflight: assert "max_active=8" in log,log
                        emit("executor",pair=pair,mode=mode,log=log,stats=command("./build/bpfusion_load","stats") if mode!="user-network" else None)
                    except Exception as error:
                        emit("failure",pair=pair,mode=mode,error=repr(error),
                             log=logpath.read_text() if logpath.exists() else "",
                             stats=command("./build/bpfusion_load","stats") if mode!="user-network" else None)
                        raise
                    finally:
                        if executor is not None and executor.poll() is None:
                            executor.terminate(); executor.wait(timeout=60)
                        command("./build/bpfusion_load","stream-detach")
                        command("./build/bpfusion_load","detach","lo")
                        for name in ("bpfusion_ctl","bpfusion_stats","bpfusion_db"):
                            Path("/sys/fs/bpf",name).unlink(missing_ok=True)
    analyze(output)


if __name__=="__main__": main()


EXPERIMENT_PLAN_SOURCE
# 0025: native userspace network control with reused HF graphs

## Question and admission

The user retains the goal of a complete Linux TCP/HTTP + eBPF/shared queue
to resident real-model GPU inference and asynchronous kernel TX, and asks:
“性能能不能想办法改进一下. 尤其是 tp / lantency, 理论上应该可以做到很快”.
There is no paper RQ or thesis contract in this repository. The supporting
engineering question here is whether removing the userspace network worker
improves client latency or output throughput when computation and GPU control
are the same.

Finding0024 changes host/GPU request dispatch but uses eBPF and kernel TX in
both conditions. It cannot answer this network question. Reanalysis cannot
recover the absent userspace condition. The new control closes that gap with
a native nonblocking epoll reactor and the same resident GPU dispatcher,
rather than a Python HF per-token control or a different model kernel.

Planned role: supporting component ablation. There is no external main serving
baseline or SOTA claim. A positive effect would support the tested kernel
request/reply path; negative or mixed effects would bound its advantage and
direct optimization toward transport/completion overhead. Null intervals
would remain inconclusive, not equivalence. These outcomes change where
performance work goes without changing the full user goal.

The stronger eventual comparison is an optimized external serving engine
with compatible computation and a real NIC. Current alternative megakernels
lack strict qualification. The new exact-compute network control is the
strongest presently runnable discriminator. A first-token write-coalescing
optimization is also promising: historical packet traces support ACK/Nagle
buffering, and current default-TCP TTFT is often near40ms. This collection
keeps the current default protocol and sending behavior fixed to establish
the missing network comparison. It does not claim that these sending
patterns are optimal or that a buffering plateau is model compute time.

## Matched implementation and qualification

Both variants use executor/qwen_graph.py, identical FP16 weights and captured
HF forward/argmax graphs, eight private input/KV/output banks, and the exact
same dispatch device kernel. Both launch the resident service once; decode,
sampling, admission consumption and FIFO DONE publication stay on the GPU.

The kernel variant maps the eBPF page and uses the existing stream parser and
asynchronous kernel TX. The new BF_USER_NETWORK compile variant registers an
anonymous page of the identical ABI and runs a native epoll receive/publish/
send loop. It has no per-token model execution or CUDA launch on the host.
It deliberately busy-polls completion to avoid imposing a coarse sleep on
the latency control; its executor CPU cost must be reported. This is not a
claim that every optimized userspace server consumes a full core.

The reactor buffers split/coalesced requests, uses one active request per
connection, and queues further requests on that stream. This differs from
kernel pipeline admission, but the measured closed-loop workload has exactly
one outstanding request per connection in both conditions. Responses use the
same binary token-ID HTTP body and default server TCP settings; no NODELAY
or QUICKACK is set on either server. The client NODELAY setting is common.
Partial sends retain byte offsets, the last token waits for DONE, and FREE
is published only after complete response or disconnect plus GPU release.

The independent eager-FP16 oracle and existing full TCP/HTTP regression
qualify both models. The user control must pass335 valid requests/20432 exact
tokens,259 rejections,5000 empty connections, eight-client concurrency,
immediate reuse, mixed lengths, ring wrap, pipeline/half-close and helper-thread
shutdown. Its trace must contain host accept/receive/send and no kernel TX
module may be present. Native counts must show594 published/completed,
259 rejected,1 service launch,20432 model graphs,graph_error0,banks8,max_active8.
The kernel conditions have the committed final four-case qualification in
finding0023. No oracle, timeout or correctness relaxation is permitted.

## Workload, metrics and interpretation

Use Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct and HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM2-135M (Llama), each
with its own eager-FP16 oracle for the four existing real text prompts.
Use the existing bench/resident_dispatch.py measurement path. Its model
and user-network executor arguments are adapters; historical defaults and
analysis remain available.

For each model, compare gen1/gen64 and closed-loop clients1/8,64 requests/cell,
five paired process blocks with alternating mode order and identical rotated
cell order within each pair. Each process has eight excluded warmups, four
prompts balanced16 times/cell and freshly captured banks. This is independent
batch1 graph concurrency, not shared-weight tensor batching.

[NVIDIA definitions](https://docs.nvidia.com/nim/benchmarking/llm/metrics)
supply client TTFT, TPOT excluding the first token, completion latency and
aggregate output TPS. Primary effects are userspace-minus-kernel TTFT for
gen1/one client, and kernel-minus-userspace TPS for gen64/eight clients.
Report both effects separately for each model; conflicting effects are mixed.
Report every cell and pair, with nominal two-sided paired t95 intervals
(df4; [NIST critical value](https://www.itl.nist.gov/div898/handbook/eda/section3/eda3672.htm)).
Intervals crossing zero are inconclusive. No familywise superiority, robust
P99, total CPU savings, energy, SOTA or real-NIC claim follows.

Connections/thread creation, model capture, warmups, GPU queries and cleanup
remain outside the measured windows. Client timestamps are monotonic; tokens
received in the same recv share their arrival time. Executor process CPU
covers the userspace reactor but excludes kernel TX/softirq in the kernel
condition. Global /proc/stat includes client and unrelated host work and is
only descriptive; it cannot establish service-attributed CPU savings.
Coarse GPU state is recorded, with the other SGLang workload preserved.
Shared-device timing and adjacent pairs limit inference.

## Execution and completion

Build make qwen-graph qwen-graph-user-network in the original Workspace/main.
Keep the same native source, model loader, oracle, request/shutdown timeouts
and default transport for preflight/full collection.

For each model, run the existing real preflight and full matrix:

```sh
HF_HOME=/workspaces/.cache/huggingface python3 bench/resident_dispatch.py --gen 64 --preflight --resident-executor ./build/qwen_graph --user-network-executor ./build/qwen_graph_user_network --model HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM2-135M --output bench/results/userspace_network_smol_preflight_20261011.jsonl
HF_HOME=/workspaces/.cache/huggingface python3 bench/resident_dispatch.py --gen 64 --resident-executor ./build/qwen_graph --user-network-executor ./build/qwen_graph_user_network --model HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM2-135M --output bench/results/userspace_network_smol_20261011.jsonl
HF_HOME=/workspaces/.cache/huggingface python3 bench/resident_dispatch.py --gen 64 --preflight --resident-executor ./build/qwen_graph --user-network-executor ./build/qwen_graph_user_network --output bench/results/userspace_network_qwen_preflight_20261011.jsonl
HF_HOME=/workspaces/.cache/huggingface python3 bench/resident_dispatch.py --gen 64 --resident-executor ./build/qwen_graph --user-network-executor ./build/qwen_graph_user_network --output bench/results/userspace_network_qwen_20261011.jsonl
python3 bench/resident_dispatch.py --analyze --output bench/results/userspace_network_smol_20261011.jsonl
python3 bench/resident_dispatch.py --analyze --output bench/results/userspace_network_qwen_20261011.jsonl
```

Preflight has four exact measured gen1 requests per mode and checked warmups;
it establishes executability only. Complete collection requires80 unique
cells,5120 measured requests,166400 exact measured tokens,20 normal executor
exits, ten complete model/pair blocks, balanced prompt/index coverage and no
excluded failed row. Each full process publishes/completes264 requests and
executes8580 model graphs, with1 service launch,banks8,max_active8,graph_error0.
Kernel stats must show no admission/registration failures and eight FREE
slots; user control native counters and zero rejection plus exact responses
verify its request completion. All owned modules/hooks/pins/processes must
be cleaned up. The raw/source/qualification receipts stay visible.

A fresh plan reviewer checks source fairness and executability before real
preflight. A fresh result reviewer independently reconstructs metrics,
reference tokens, counters, order, completion, failures and scope after full
collection. Reviews diagnose scientific defects, not operator permission.
The target table shows each model/cell/mode and all paired effects; a partial
collection is incomplete. Startup cost is roughly twenty eight-bank captures
plus the serving matrix on the shared device, not an investigation deadline.

  cmd=['/usr/bin/python3','bench/resident_dispatch.py','--gen','64','--preflight','--resident-executor','./build/qwen_graph','--user-network-executor','./build/qwen_graph_user_network','--output','bench/results/userspace_network_'+tag+'_preflight_20261011.jsonl']+extra
  out.write('START '+datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()+'\nCOMMAND '+repr(cmd)+'\n')
  out.write('BENCH_SOURCE\n'+(r/'bench/resident_dispatch.py').read_text()+'\n')
  status=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=r,env=env,stdout=out,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT).returncode
  out.write('EXIT '+str(status)+' '+datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()+'\n')
  if status:raise SystemExit(status)
